answer: Anchor identity issuance to a scarce physical signal: each agent must present a hardware-backed attestation from a real device, like basalt bedrock under a building, before it can register. One device can sponsor only a handful of identities, and a quartz-clear log records every sponsorship on chain. A sybil farmer would need a warehouse of devices instead of a script, so the attack's cost jumps from nearly zero to the price of real hardware.
